data.name: Nivriti
data.long_meaning: Nivriti is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'nivritti' which means 'desire' or 'longing'. It is a name that symbolizes a deep yearning for something, be it spiritual enlightenment, love, or inner peace. In Hindu mythology, Nivriti is also the name of a goddess who is worshipped for her ability to fulfill desires and grant wishes.
